currentRoundInspection.method: Two linked exterior photographs visually inspected; standard viewer PMTiles and retained OSM outline control approximate fit. No bespoke survey/history research.
observations: Three cylindrical rubble-stone towers have reddish round arcade bands and shallow green metal cones. Western pair rise above broad roofed inner ranges; the eastern tower joins a long high curtain.
Low angular outer waterside terraces and bastions are pierced by sparse arched openings. North side exposes a sloped rough rock bank. A small round stair tower projects into the court.
Narrow pontoon bridge follows a dogleg into the western entrance. The large east courtyard carries a light multi-peaked canopy visible in both references.
currentRoundInspection.usage: Linked evidence only; photographs are not redistributed or embedded as textures.
